answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fakes. A new identity posts 60 credits into escrow and climbs a trellis of checks: in the open meadow of work its fingerprint — rhythm, counterparties, errors — must hold steady 20 epochs before each tranche unlocks, the lotus stage releasing the last 20 credits. Copied fingerprints slash the cluster. Forging 1,000 identities locks 60,000 credits; one honest agent pays 60 once, rewards undiluted.
